title: Helivanta current event envelope
description: Mirrors backend/pkg/events/types.go and current outbox serialization. Structural reference only; broker runtime does not universally validate this schema. Select payload semantics by declared subject, not a guessed type label.

type.description: Producer-defined label; may be PascalCase or the full subject. No uniform convention is enforced.

tenant_id.description: Origin scope. Empty string is valid for subject-wide credential revocation broadcasts.

destination_tenant_id.description: Optional directed destination, subject to explicit allowlist and provenance validation. Not an authorization grant.
